nom: medicube Capsule Cream with Deep Vitamin C

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin found the cream heavy and greasy for daytime facial use, though one with oily, sensitive skin liked it applied at night without breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or very dry skin consistently describe the cream as deeply and lastingly hydrating, some calling it a go-to during harsh winter weather despite a sticky finish.
segments.combination: One reviewer recommends the cream for combination as well as dry or mature skin that needs hydration without heaviness.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation and good tolerance even alongside actives like vitamin C or tretinoin, but one acne-prone, fungal-acne-prone, sensitive-skin reviewer had a severe breakout within two days.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 60s, including one who names 'dry/aging skin' and one describing 'menopause skin', report smoother fine lines, fading age spots and a plumper look after weeks of use.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers in their 40s-60s report fewer fine lines, softened crow's feet and fading age spots after three or more weeks of consistent use, with one year-long user saying her fine lines 'decreased substantially'.
concerns.dehydration: This is the concern reviewers report the most improvement on: many with dry or winter-damaged skin describe full-day or 24-hour hydration; a few found the effect only mild, noting hydration without any other visible change.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers say the cream calmed redness, including post-acne redness and on post-procedure skin, though one reviewer's skin became increasingly reactive and inflamed within two days of starting it.
concerns.barrier: Two reviewers credit the formula's ceramides, panthenol and allantoin with repairing and soothing the skin barrier while healing from breakouts or preventing dryness and irritation.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading dark spots, hyperpigmentation or discoloration and a more even tone within two to three weeks; dissenting reviewers found good hydration but no noticeable change in their dark spots, and one criticizes the actual kojic-acid concentration as too low to target pigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Reports diverge sharply: several reviewers with acne-prone or cystic-acne skin describe calmer breakouts and soothed, healing texture, while the most critical reviewer describes the opposite, small pimples taking over her previously clear face within two days.
concerns.oiliness: Two reviewers with oily skin found the cream too rich and greasy for daytime facial wear and moved it to body use instead, while one oily-and-sensitive reviewer used it successfully at night without extra shine or breakouts.

This is hands down the best moisturizer I’ve ever used. This moisturizer keeps my super dry skin hydrated for a full 24 hours in the cold, dry Minnesota November weather, and would get 5 stars from me if it wasn’t a little sticky. Personally, I believe this product is comparable to the Neutrogena Hydro Boost. Just a small amount keeps my face and neck moisturized all day, while leaving behind a coveted glass-doll glow. There is a slight stickiness to this product immediately after applying so I don’t recommend trying to put a whole blue capsule on your face like you see in the picture (I tried it because it looked cool, wasted a lot). The stickiness does go away awhile after applying and leaves nothing but hydrated skin. This moisturizer is the ultimate dry-skin guru!

extraits.titre: Deeply hydrating and leaves my skin soft, plump, and glowing!
extraits.texte: I've been using the Medicube Salmon DNA PDRN Capsule Cream every evening for about a month, and it has become one of my favorite moisturizers. I was looking for a cream that would deeply hydrate my skin, strengthen my skin barrier, and leave my complexion looking healthy and radiant—and this definitely delivered. What worked well: The capsule formula melts into the skin as you apply it, leaving my face feeling incredibly soft and nourished without feeling greasy. After a few weeks of consistent use, I noticed my skin looked smoother, more hydrated, and noticeably plumper. I wake up every morning with skin that feels refreshed and has a healthy glow. It also layers beautifully over my serums and doesn't pill under sunscreen or makeup. What could be improved: I don't have any major complaints. If you have very oily skin, you may find it a little rich for daytime use, but it's perfect as a nighttime moisturizer. Who I'd recommend it to: I would recommend this cream to anyone with dry, dehydrated, combination, or mature skin looking for long-lasting hydration and a brighter, healthier-looking complexion. It's especially great if you're trying to improve your skin barrier or achieve a more radiant, "glass skin" look. Was the description accurate? Yes! The product looked exactly like the listing. The capsule texture was unique and fun to use, and it performed exactly as described. A little goes a long way, so the jar should last quite a while. Overall, I'm extremely happy with this

extraits.titre: Title: Good hydration, but no noticeable change in dark spots.
extraits.texte: I've been using this cream for a few months now, although I haven't been completely consistent with it. Whenever I apply it, my skin feels very hydrated and soft, and the next day it looks healthy and is easy to manage. The texture is pleasant and it doesn't feel heavy on my skin. The reason I'm giving it 5 stars is because I really enjoy the moisturizing effect and how comfortable it feels. However, I personally haven't noticed much improvement in some of the dark spots I was hoping it would help with. Even so, I like using it and will continue incorporating it into my skincare routine for the hydration benefits.
